newsitem.title: FRANCE: Airbus says will monitor details of EU/Boeing deal.
newsitem.headline: Airbus says will monitor details of EU/Boeing deal.

text.p: European aircraft consortium Airbus Industrie said on Wednesday it would monitor closely the details of a deal under which the European Union approved in principle a merger between Boeing Co and McDonnell Douglas Corp.

"Airbus Industrie takes note of the Commission's decision but has no immediate comment to make because it has no knowledge of the last minute concessions made by Boeing to counter the Commission's objections to the merger," Airbus spokesman Alain Dupeich told Reuters by telephone from Toulouse in south-west France.
"Airbus Industrie regrets, however, the arrogant and confrontational attitude of the U.S.A. in these discussions," he added.
"The unnecessary tension could have been avoided had Boeing proposed true remedies to contentious points raised by the Commission at the outset of the talks," Dupiech said.
"Throughout, the Europeans were intend on examining whether the proposed merger was in conformity with European competition rules. At no time were the words ''trade war'' spoken in Europe," he added.
"In any event, Airbus Industrie will vigilantly monitor the terms and conditions of the merger agreement -- when known -- to ensure they are strictly adhered to," Dupiech said.
